faq_heading: Homes near Chief Dan George Middle: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Chief Dan George Middle catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Chief Dan George Middle home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Chief Dan George Middle, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Chief Dan George Middle sell for?
faq.a: Within 1.5 km of the school, 210 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $932,500, townhomes $557,500, condos $388,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Chief Dan George Middle?
faq.a: Within 1.5 km of Chief Dan George Middle the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 210 homes within 1.5 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Chief Dan George Middle?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Cornerstone Christian School (0.8 km north) and John Maclure Community School (1.2 km south).

How the Chief Dan George Middle search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Chief Dan George Middle, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1.5 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Chief Dan George Middle

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Chief Dan George Middle in a straight line (8 elementary, 3 other, 2 secondary, 2 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Ten Broeck Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is W J Mouat Secondary (1.5 km); the nearest independent school is Cornerstone Christian School (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is W J Mouat Secondary (1.5 km). Other middle schools close by: Colleen And Gordie Howe Middle School (1.5 km south-west), Abbotsford Middle School (2.9 km south).
